text: It seems he has been collecting scraps from the news over the years. These articles go back decades.
alt: There are newspapers on the floor as well. 'Monday, April 13th, Nineteen-Ninety-Something. The Common Hornographer. Space Rocks Knock Local Burb's Block Off. Populace oblivious to broad significance of events, assuming there is any, which there definitely isn't. Shortly after 4 A.M. today, a downpour of meteors in a residential neighborhood became yet another instance in a pattern of recent rockey cosmological phenomena. The incident, aside from property damage and loss of life, was downplayed by authorities as 'not all that big of a deal'.
command: John: Look at the piece of paper taped to the wall.
